verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KATONDA eyantonda nze
Mu mubiri-omwangu;
Ndyoke nnyinze-okusobola
-Okutambula wonna;
Singa mbuliddwa-amagezi,
Naye mujjukira
Mu mutima ogw'essanyu
Ng'omwana omuto.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yesu Kabaka, Mukama;
Ompe-ekitala kyo
Ekyangu era ekyogi
Nnwanyise-abalabe;
Ndyoke mbawangule abo,
Era nkuweereze
-Emisana era n'ekiro,
Mbeerenga-omusajja.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Omwoyo ogw'amazima
Oguwa-omubiri
-Essanyu mu kifo ky'ennyombo,
-Omusana-omulungi;
Amagezi nga gambuze
Ojje embeerenga;
Ompe ekirabo kino
-Otwale-omwoyo gwange.
